title: APK Forge
profTagline: Turn any web app into an installable Android APK — right here, no build server. Enter a URL, get a signed WebView-wrapper APK with the site's name and icon, ready to sideload.
forgeNote: Sideload only. On Samsung, turn Auto Blocker off (Settings → Security & privacy) or install over adb, then allow unknown sources.
installDesc: Add APK Forge to your home screen for full-screen, offline use.
installIosHint: Tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
installGenericHint: Open the browser menu and choose “Install app”.
